lines.en: label bar40:
scene barwalkhome1
: Oh...Sensei.
lines.zh: : 啊……Sensei。

lines.en: : Um...you have...pretty bad timing tonight...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你今晚来得……真不是时候……

lines.en: I show up at the bar a little later than normal to find Sana already prepared to leave.
lines.zh: 我比平时到得晚了一些，一进酒吧就发现 Sana 已经准备要走了。

lines.en: I slide my phone out of my pocket to check the time and, even though it's late, it’s nowhere near closing time yet.
lines.zh: 我掏出手机看了看时间，虽然确实晚了，但离打烊还早得很。

lines.en: Well, actually, I guess closing time in a place like this is whenever the person running it wants it to be, so...
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，这种地方的打烊时间本来就全看老板的心情，所以……

lines.en: I’m sure Sara has something to do with this.
lines.zh: 这事儿八成跟 Sara 有关。

lines.en: : Leaving already?
lines.zh: : 这就走了？

lines.en: : Isn’t it a little too early?
lines.zh: : 是不是太早了点？

lines.en: : Normally...yes.
lines.zh: : 平时……是挺早的。

lines.en: : But we closed half an hour ago...
lines.zh: : 可我们半小时前就打烊了……

lines.en: : You should learn to read signs, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你该学学看牌子。

lines.en: : Those big letters on the door that say “closed” mean we’re not open.
lines.zh: : 门上那几个写着“打烊了”的大字，意思就是我们不营业了。

lines.en: : I blame you for changing the hours so suddenly and throwing me off.
lines.zh: : 都怪你突然改营业时间，把我搞糊涂了。

lines.en: : What’s the reason you're closing so early tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚为什么这么早就关门？

lines.en: scene barwalkhome2
: I...don’t really know either, to be honest...
lines.zh: : 说实话……我也不太清楚……

lines.en: : I think my mom isn’t feeling well, but...that doesn’t mean I couldn’t look after the place myself...
lines.zh: : 我想我妈是不太舒服，可……那也不代表我就看不了店……

lines.en: : Don’t listen to her. I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 别听她的。我没事。

lines.en: : Just figured it would be good for the two of us to get some time off.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，我们俩也该好好歇一歇了。

lines.en: : Ideally, Sana would have come upstairs to hang out with me, but she keeps talking about how tired she is.
lines.zh: : 我本来想让 Sana 上楼陪我，可她一直念叨着自己有多累。

lines.en: : The walk back is kind of long, so...if I can start heading back earlier I...probably should.
lines.zh: : 回去的路挺远的，所以……要是能早点动身……我大概就该早点走。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome3
: Yeah, yeah. Go home and sleep.
lines.zh: : 行行行。回家睡觉去吧。

lines.en: : I’ll just sit upstairs and do my best Haru-chan impression by watching movies and eating ice cream until I pass out.
lines.zh: : 我就在楼上待着，努力模仿一下 Haru-chan——看电影吃冰淇淋，直到昏睡过去。

lines.en: : Better habit than drinking until you pass out, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少比喝到昏过去的习惯好点。

lines.en: : Is it really, though?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Um...S-Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……S-Sensei？

lines.en: : You wouldn’t want to...maybe...
lines.zh: : 你愿不愿意……那个……

lines.en: scene barwalkhome4
: W...Walk back with me...would you?
lines.zh: : 陪、陪我走回去……可以吗？

lines.en: : He’s got no choice. We’re closed for the night.
lines.zh: : 他没得选。我们今晚关门了。

lines.en: : Wow. You’re not offering to keep the place open as a special favor to me?
lines.zh: : 哇。你都不打算为了我特别通融一下，继续营业吗？

lines.en: : You really aren’t feeling well, are-
lines.zh: : 你真的是不舒服吧——

lines.en: : I said I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我说了没事。

lines.en: : ...Okay.
: Um...is that a...no?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那是……不行吗？

lines.en: : Not at all. Of course I’ll walk back with you.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。我当然陪你走回去。

lines.en: : I came here to see you again, so it’s not like there’s anything else I have planned for tonight.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿本来就是为了再见你一面，今晚也没别的安排。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome5
: Really?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……

lines.en: : I...walk kind of slow since my legs are really small, so...I hope that’s not a bother...
lines.zh: : 我……走路有点慢，因为腿真的很短，所以……希望不会给你添麻烦……

lines.en: : I could always just carry you home instead if you want.
lines.zh: : 要不我干脆直接把你抱回家得了。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine you weigh more than a six pack of beer.
lines.zh: : 我实在想不出你能比一提六罐的啤酒重多少。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome6
: You don’t have to carry me...
lines.zh: : 你不用抱我……

lines.en: : And I...definitely weigh more than...a six pack of beer...
lines.zh: : 而且我……绝对比……一提啤酒重……

lines.en: : Jump into my arms and prove it.
lines.zh: : 那你跳进我怀里证明一下。

lines.en: : Maybe I should walk home alone after all?...
lines.zh: : 要不我还是一个人走回去吧？……

lines.en: : I’m kidding...
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的……

lines.en: I really wasn’t, though.
lines.zh: 不过我其实没开玩笑。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome7
: Hahah...y-yeah...I figured as much...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是、是吗……我就知道……

lines.en: : But, umm...I guess we should head out so...my mom can start doing her...Haruka impression.
lines.zh: : 不过，嗯……我们还是出发吧，好让……我妈开始她的……Haruka 模仿秀。

lines.en: : For real. I gave you both the green light to abandon little ole’ me and you’re still standing there talking.
lines.zh: : 说真的。我都给你们开绿灯让你们丢下我这老太婆了，你们还站在这儿聊。

lines.en: : Am I really that irresistible?
lines.zh: : 我就这么让人舍不得走吗？

lines.en: : {i}It certainly feels that way sometimes...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有时候确实让人有这种感觉……{/i}

lines.en: scene barwalkhome8
: A-Anyway...let’s start walking, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 总、总之……我们走吧，Sensei……

lines.en: : I know a...pretty quick way back, so...we’ll get there in no time.
lines.zh: : 我知道一条……挺近的路，所以……很快就到了。

lines.en: scene black
I follow Sana out of the bar, taking a look over my shoulder to see if Sara has changed expressions now that we’re finally leaving.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Sana 走出酒吧，回头看了一眼 Sara，想知道我们终于走了以后她表情有没有变。

lines.en: She had a pretty...interesting moment when I saw her in Sana’s room recently, so I wouldn’t be surprised if this somehow had something to do with that.
lines.zh: 前不久我在 Sana 房间里见她时，她有过一个相当……有意思的瞬间，所以如果这事跟那有关，我一点也不意外。

lines.en: Perhaps more interesting, though, is how Sana has finally agreed to walk home with me.
lines.zh: 不过更有意思的是，Sana 终于答应让我陪她走回家了。

lines.en: I feel like I’ve offered this countless times in the past, so I figured the first time it actually happened would be the result of yet another one of my invites.
lines.zh: 这种话我以前提过无数次了，我还以为真有那么一天，也一定又是我先开口邀的。

lines.en: But, strangely enough, she’s the one who invited me.
lines.zh: 可奇怪的是，这次是她先开口的。

lines.en: Here’s hoping her “really small legs” don’t provide much of a hindrance to what I imagine will be a relatively peaceful walk back.
lines.zh: 只希望她那双“真的很短的腿”别太拖后腿，让我原本想象中还算平静的回家路泡汤。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome9
As expected, we don’t have the easiest time thinking up conversation topics as we wander down the streets toward the dorms.
lines.zh: 果不其然，我们一路朝宿舍走，想找话题并不容易。

lines.en: I hate having to take the lead in situations like this. It’s exhausting.
lines.zh: 我讨厌在这种场合里当那个起头的。太累了。

lines.en: Putting two people together who struggle with that same exact thing turns what could be a sweet event in a romantic comedy into a night that will be easy to look back on and cringe.
lines.zh: 两个同样不擅长这件事的人凑到一起，本该是浪漫喜剧里的甜蜜桥段，硬是变成了一个让人回想起来就尴尬的夜晚。

lines.en: {i}Why did it take so long for us to break the silence?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我们为什么花了那么久才打破沉默？{/i}

lines.en: {i}There were so many other things we could have talked about.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}明明还有那么多别的事可以聊。{/i}

lines.en: Things like that.
lines.zh: 诸如此类的话。

lines.en: Things you think but never say.
lines.zh: 想说却永远说出口的话。

lines.en: So, in layman’s terms-
lines.zh: 所以，说白了——

lines.en: Most things.
lines.zh: 大多数事都是。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome10
: How...tall do you feel right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在……觉得自己有多高？

lines.en: : Like a giant.
lines.zh: : 像个巨人。

lines.en: : I always forget how short you are until you’re standing right next to me.
lines.zh: : 每次你不站在我旁边，我就会忘了你有多矮。

lines.en: : It probably helps that I...don’t get to stand next to you all that often...
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我……不常有机会站在你旁边吧……

lines.en: : I’m happy I...got to tonight, though...
lines.zh: : 不过今晚能这样站着，我很开心……

lines.en: : I’m surprised you were feeling up to this all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 你突然愿意这样，我挺意外的。

lines.en: : I feel like I’ve tried to do this with you a bunch of times now.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得这种事我已经跟你提过好多次了。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome11
: Y-Yeah...even though I’m happy, it...still feels really weird...
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……虽然我很开心，可……还是觉得怪怪的……

lines.en: : Who would have thought that...someone who has so much trouble making friends would...wind up having a guy {i}your{/i} age as one?...
lines.zh: : 谁能想到……一个交朋友这么费劲的人……最后交到的朋友会是个{i}你这个{/i}年纪的男人呢？……

lines.en: : Are you calling me old, Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana，你是在说我老吗？

lines.en: scene barwalkhome12
: Super old...old enough to be my dad, probably...
lines.zh: : 超级老……大概老得能当我爸了……

lines.en: : I’m sure your mother would love that.
lines.zh: : 你妈妈肯定很乐意。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome13
: Yeah...she definitely would...
lines.zh: : 是啊……她肯定乐意……

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure...that might be what she’s trying to do...
lines.zh: : 我敢说……她大概就是在往那个方向努力……

lines.en: : It would be nice if...she picked someone I didn’t know, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……她要是挑个我不认识的人就好了……

lines.en: : First, you say I’m old. Now, you’re saying you wouldn’t want me as a father?
lines.zh: : 你先说我老，现在又说不想让我当你爸？

lines.en: : Sana, do you actually hate me?
lines.zh: : Sana，你其实很讨厌我吗？

lines.en: : What? No...of course not...
lines.zh: : 什么？不……当然不是……

lines.en: : I just...can’t really ever think of you as...being that kind of person to me...
lines.zh: : 我只是……真的没法把你想成……那样的一个人……

lines.en: : But...then again...it’s not like I really...understand what that kind of person would feel like in the first place...
lines.zh: : 不过……话说回来……我本来也……不太明白那样的人应该是什么感觉……

lines.en: scene barwalkhome14
: You’re actually...kind of the closest thing I’ve ever had to...someone like that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，其实……你大概是我这辈子最接近……那样的人了。

lines.en: : Already? I feel like we still barely even know each other.
lines.zh: : 这就已经了？我觉得我们才刚认识没多久。

lines.en: : Y...yeah...I know that...
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……我知道……

lines.en: : But all I really know about my dad is...what I’ve heard from my mom...
lines.zh: : 可关于我爸，我真正知道的……全都是我妈告诉我的……

lines.en: : And I think you’ve realized by now, but...she doesn’t really open up a lot...
lines.zh: : 我想你也看出来了……她其实不怎么敞开心扉……

lines.en: : Well, what kind of things {i}has{/i} she told you?
lines.zh: : 那她{i}到底{/i}跟你说了些什么？

lines.en: scene barwalkhome15
: Do you want...the good things or the bad things?...
lines.zh: : 你想听……好的还是坏的？……

lines.en: : Just a general synopsis would be fine, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概讲个梗概就行吧。

lines.en: : Then...
: He wasn’t very loyal...
lines.zh: : 他不太忠诚……

lines.en: : My mom has always been...kind of naive...and I think he was stringing her along...
lines.zh: : 我妈一直……有点单纯……我觉得他是在吊着她……

lines.en: : She said he always seemed nice to her in[school], but...he was also a lot older than her, so...he was probably just...good at manipulating her...
lines.zh: : 她说他在[school]里对她一直挺温柔的，可……他比她大很多，所以……他大概只是……很会哄她……

lines.en: : It wasn’t until after I was born that...she found out he’d been seeing other girls...
lines.zh: : 直到我出生以后……她才发现他一直跟别的女人来往……

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: And of course her father is the mirror image of me. Great.
lines.zh: 当然了，她父亲简直就是我的翻版。真好。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s no way that’s going to bite me in the ass eventually.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，这事儿将来绝对不会反咬我一口。

lines.en: : So...when I say you’re the closest thing I’ve had to someone like that...it’s not because I think we’re close yet...
lines.zh: : 所以……我说你是我最接近那样的人……不是因为我觉得我们已经很亲近了……

lines.en: : There’s just...not any competition...
lines.zh: : 只是……没有别人能比……

lines.en: : You win by default...
lines.zh: : 你算是躺赢……

lines.en: : So, Sara really raised you by herself then, huh?
lines.zh: : 这么说，Sara 真是一个人把你们带大的？

lines.en: scene barwalkhome16
: Yeah but...not just me...My brother, too.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过……不止是我……还有我哥哥。

lines.en: : She raised both of us all by herself...
lines.zh: : 她一个人把我们俩都拉扯大了……

lines.en: : It was probably...really hard...
lines.zh: : 那一定……很不容易……

lines.en: : That’s why...I don’t like trying to get her to talk about the past...
lines.zh: : 所以……我不喜欢逼她聊过去的事……

lines.en: scene barwalkhome13
: And when I brought up something that reminded her of my brother the other night...
lines.zh: : 前几晚我提起了让我妈想起我哥哥的事……

lines.en: : It made me feel like it was my fault she...started to break down...
lines.zh: : 她后来情绪崩溃，我觉得都是我的错……

lines.en: : I had a feeling it was something like that.
lines.zh: : 我就猜到是这么回事。

lines.en: : I had a feeling that...you had a feeling about that...
lines.zh: : 我就猜到……你会猜到……

lines.en: : I’m sorry for not saying goodbye, by the way...
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，那天没跟你道别，对不起……

lines.en: : I just...don’t normally see my mom like that and...I needed to make sure she didn’t get any worse...
lines.zh: : 我只是……平时没见过我妈那个样子……我得确认她不会再恶化……

lines.en: : It was my fault for bringing something nostalgic up anyway...
lines.zh: : 说到底，是我先提了那种让人怀旧的事……

lines.en: : I don’t think you should blame yourself for that. Avoiding the past is impossible.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不用为此自责。过去是躲不掉的。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome17
: No...it’s really not...
lines.zh: : 不……真的躲不掉……

lines.en: : If there’s anything I’ve learned from my mom, it’s that...denial can be a really good tool sometimes...
lines.zh: : 要说我从我妈身上学到了什么，那就是……逃避有时候真的是个很好用的工具……

lines.en: : It’s hard for me since...I loved my brother a lot, but...
lines.zh: : 对我来说已经很难了，因为……我很爱我哥哥，可是……

lines.en: : Can you imagine how much harder it was for her?...
lines.zh: : 你能想象对她来说有多难吗？……

lines.en: : She...made him...and watched him grow up...
lines.zh: : 她……生下了他……看着他长大……

lines.en: : Which of these two things sounds easier, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei，这两件事哪件听起来更容易？……

lines.en: : Learning to cope with...the person you love more than anything in the world suddenly going away-
lines.zh: : 学着接受……你在这世上最爱的人突然消失不见——

lines.en: : Or just...ignoring that it ever happened.
lines.zh: : 还是干脆……当它从来没发生过。

lines.en: : The second one sounds easier, absolutely.
lines.zh: : 绝对是第二种听起来更容易。

lines.en: : Right...so-
lines.zh: : 对吧……所以——

lines.en: : Something being easy doesn’t mean it’s the right thing to do, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，容易做的事不代表就是对的事。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome18
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 啊？你是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that bottling things like that up can literally kill people.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，把这种事一直憋在心里，是真的会要人命的。

lines.en: : But...so can grief.
lines.zh: : 可……悲伤也一样会。

lines.en: : No matter what we do, we’re going to...keep hurting.
lines.zh: : 不管我们怎么做，还是……会一直痛下去。

lines.en: : A third of our family was taken away from us...
lines.zh: : 我们家三分之一的人被夺走了……

lines.en: : All we can do is...help each other deal with that any way we can...
lines.zh: : 我们能做的，只有……用尽办法互相扶持着熬过去……

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
: Didn’t you tell me when you were drunk that you wished Sara {i}would{/i} talk about it, though?
lines.zh: : 可你喝醉的时候不是跟我说过，你希望 Sara {i}能{/i}聊聊这件事吗？

lines.en: scene barwalkhome19
: Things you do or say when...you’re drunk...don’t count...
lines.zh: : 喝醉的时候……做的事说的话……不算数……

lines.en: : That’s an incredibly dangerous thing for someone working in a bar to be saying.
lines.zh: : 在酒吧打工的人说这种话，可真是危险至极。

lines.en: : Yes, but...it’s something I need to think or...everything will get even worse than it already is...
lines.zh: : 是没错，可……我必须这么想，不然……情况只会比现在更糟……

lines.en: scene barwalkhome20
: Oh no! I...I made this a really awkward walk all of a sudden!
lines.zh: : 啊糟了！我……我突然把这段路搞得好尴尬！

lines.en: : Wh-what were we talking about at first?
lines.zh: : 我、我们最开始聊的是什么来着？

lines.en: : How I’m the closest you’ve ever had to a father figure.
lines.zh: : 说我算是你这辈子最接近父亲的人。

lines.en: : Th-that’s awkward, too! Wh-wh-what was our last {i}normal{/i} conversation about? Let’s go back to that!
lines.zh: : 那、那个也尴尬！我、我们上一段{i}正常{/i}的对话是什么来着？我们聊回那个吧！

lines.en: : I think that was just about how tall I am.
lines.zh: : 大概是我有多高吧。

lines.en: : So tall! The tallest!
lines.zh: : 好高！最高！

lines.en: : Sana, calm down. It’s okay that things got awkward for a few minutes.
lines.zh: : Sana，冷静点。尴尬几分钟没关系。

lines.en: : If you’re embarrassed about it, just look at it as another exercise in public speaking.
lines.zh: : 你要是觉得不好意思，就当是又一次当众讲话的练习。

lines.en: : You were able to talk at length about something that makes you uncomfortable, and now I know more about you as a result.
lines.zh: : 你能把一件让你难受的事讲得那么详细，我也因此更了解你了。

lines.en: scene barwalkhome21
: Uh...uh-huh...
: But now it will probably be a little bit harder for me to...spend time with you when you could just...go hang out with Ayane instead and...avoid my awkwardness...
lines.zh: : 不过这样一来，我大概更不好意思……跟你待在一起了，反正你大可以……去找 Ayane，躲开我的尴尬……

lines.en: : At least when...she compares you to a dad, she...knows what she’s talking about...
lines.zh: : 至少……她把你比作爸爸的时候……是知道自己在说什么的……

lines.en: : Good point.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : Maybe I should just adopt the two of you and get it over with?
lines.zh: : 要不我干脆把你们俩都收养了，一了百了？

lines.en: : I think you’d...have to marry my mom to be able to adopt me...
lines.zh: : 我想你……得先娶了我妈才能收养我吧……

lines.en: : I feel like there are several people who would be very unhappy with me if that were to happen.
lines.zh: : 我觉得真要那样，会有好几个人对我非常不满。

lines.en: : And...one of them is right next to you...
lines.zh: : 而……其中一个就在你旁边……

lines.en: : But it’s okay...
lines.zh: : 不过没关系……

lines.en: : Like I said...I don’t view you that way...
lines.zh: : 我也说了……我没有那样看你……

lines.en: : I’m...perfectly fine if things just...stay like this...
lines.zh: : 只要……一直保持现在这样……我就……很满足了……

lines.en: : That would be...the easiest thing for everyone...
lines.zh: : 那样对所有人来说……都是最容易的……

lines.en: : You’re really fine with things never changing?
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得一直不变也没关系？

lines.en: scene barwalkhome22
: Actually...
lines.zh: : 其实……

lines.en: : When I say this would be the easiest thing for everyone...I really just mean me...
lines.zh: : 我说那样对所有人最容易……其实只是对我最容易……

lines.en: : If you get any closer to Ayane...you’ll get further away from me.
lines.zh: : 你跟 Ayane 再亲近一点……就会离我更远一点。

lines.en: : If you get any closer to my mom...you’ll get further away from me.
lines.zh: : 你跟我妈再亲近一点……就会离我更远一点。

lines.en: : And if...
lines.zh: : 而如果……

lines.en: : You get any closer to me...
lines.zh: : 你跟我再亲近一点……

lines.en: Sana never finishes that thought but, through context clues and my unparalleled wisdom in the world of [teenage]girls, I’m able to ascertain what she means.
lines.zh: Sana 终究没把那句话说完，但靠着上下文线索，以及我在[teenage]女孩这门学问上无人能及的造诣，我琢磨出了她的意思。

lines.en: She’s afraid of her feelings for me growing.
lines.zh: 她害怕她对我的感情会长大。

lines.en: {s}Growing like a tree.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}像树一样长大。{/s}

lines.en: She’s afraid of what she’ll have to do and what she’ll have to go through if she, too, falls victim to my suspicious gravitational pull on all of these girls.
lines.zh: 她害怕的是，如果她也陷进我对这些女孩那种可疑的引力里，自己将不得不做什么、又得熬过什么。

lines.en: Take Ayane, Sara, and me and arrange us so we form a triangle.
lines.zh: 把 Ayane、Sara 和我摆成一个三角形。

lines.en: Right now, Sana is in the middle of the triangle- and she wants to get out.
lines.zh: 而现在，Sana 就在这个三角形的中央——她想出去。

lines.en: The only way to do that is by breaking one of the lines.
lines.zh: 唯一的办法，就是断掉其中一条边。

lines.en: Breaking a line means the triangle would crumble.
lines.zh: 断掉一条边，三角形就塌了。

lines.en: So, just like her mother-
lines.zh: 所以，就像她母亲一样——

lines.en: She doesn’t try to change anything.
lines.zh: 她什么也不去改变。

lines.en: She stays exactly where she is and waits for everything else to resolve on its own.
lines.zh: 她就待在原地，等着一切自行解决。

lines.en: It’s a horrible way to live.
lines.zh: 这是一种糟糕透顶的活法。

lines.en: A horrible, impassive way to live-
lines.zh: 一种糟糕透顶、麻木不仁的活法——

lines.en: That I, too, am guilty of in more ways than one.
lines.zh: 而不止在一件事上，我自己也犯着同样的罪。
